sloka: अद्भुतश्च विचित्रश्च तेषामासीत् समागमः ।तत्र वानरसैन्यानां शलभानामिवोद्यमः ।। ६.४१.४८ ।।।।
transliteration: adbhutaśca vicitraśca teṣāmāsīt samāgamaḥ ।tatra vānarasainyānāṁ śalabhānāmivodyamaḥ ।। 6.41.48 ।।।।

translations.english: Few monkeys had strength of an ogha, some had a hundred times more, and the monkey commanders possessed immeasurable strength.
